headline: Confederation Of African Football Reschedules 2026 Awards Ceremony
metaDescription: The Confederation of African Football has moved its 2026 Awards ceremony in Lagos to December 2, adjusting from the original date of December 7.
aiSummaryBullets: The 2026 Confederation of African Football Awards have been rescheduled to December 2.
The event was originally set to take place on December 7 in Lagos.
Reports suggest the date change aims to facilitate the attendance of players currently based at European clubs.
aiContextParagraph: The Confederation of African Football has officially adjusted the schedule for its 2026 Awards ceremony, moving the event forward by five days. While the organization has not issued an official statement regarding the specific cause for the change, local media reports indicate that the shift to December 2 is intended to accommodate the availability of players who are currently signed to European football clubs. The gala is slated to take place in Lagos, which remains the host city for the event honoring the top talent in the sport across the continent. This adjustment moves the ceremony from its previously announced date of December 7, impacting the planned timeline for one of African football's most significant annual gatherings. The event serves as a platform to recognize outstanding performances by players, coaches, and administrators throughout the preceding year.
whyItIsViral: The event is gaining attention due to interest from football fans regarding the participation of high-profile athletes and the logistics of the prestigious regional awards.

sources.articleTitle: CAF Awards 2026: Lagos set to host Africa’s biggest stars as ceremony gets new date
